qmaster_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Grid Engine qmaster (scheduler) server.

qmaster_port.description: TCP port on which the qmaster listens (standard: 6444).

spool_dir.description: Spool directory where the execd stores job state and spooled files.

execd_spool_dir.description: Execution spool directory (identical to spool_dir in most setups).

execd_java_dir.description: Directory used for temporary files (job staging, I/O buffering).

hostname.description: Name of this execution host — must match its registered name in qmaster.

execd_port.description: TCP port on which the execd listens (standard: 6445).

max_user_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs per user (0 = unlimited).

max_ujperq.description: Maximum number of jobs per queue per user (0 = unlimited).

max_pe_jobs.description: Maximum number of parallel environment jobs this host can host.

load_thresholds.description: CPU load thresholds for scheduling decisions (e.g., load_avg, load_mem, load_swap).

items.description: Load value above which the host is marked as busy (e.g., 0.5 = 50% load).

slots.description: Number of execution slots (jobs) this host accepts; 'auto' auto-detects cores/threads.

packages.description: List of software package definitions available to jobs (e.g., 'intel', 'matlab').

cpu_affinity.description: CPU affinity mode: 'none' (no pinning), 'auto' (auto-detect), or 'explicit' (use pinning config).

auto_shutdown.description: If true, the execd automatically shuts down when idle for auto_shutdown_delay seconds.

auto_shutdown_delay.description: Seconds of idle time before auto-shutdown triggers (only if auto_shutdown=true).

shell_start_mode.description: Shell invocation mode — 'unix:0' means interactive login shell for jobs.

job_env_vars.description: Extra environment variables exported to each job (e.g., { 'MODULEPATH': '/opt/modules' }).

prolog.description: Absolute path to script executed before each job starts (may set up environment).

epilog.description: Absolute path to script executed after each job completes (e.g., for cleanup/logging).

reporting.description: Enable resource usage reporting (CPU, memory, I/O) to qmaster.

loglevel.description: Minimum severity level for log messages written to logdir.

logdir.description: Directory where execd writes log files.
